title: Add local RAG catalog with plugin scaffold and typesafe tool bindings
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add a local-first RAG catalog example demonstrating a plugin scaffold, typesafe tool bindings, immutable incremental indexes, and telemetry masking hooks. Useful for dev onboarding and safe PII handling in demos.
description:
Motivation: provide a compact, developer-friendly RAG quickstart that emphasizes local-first iteration, safe telemetry, and a typesafe plugin API for tool-calling. This PR introduces a lightweight 'local-rag-catalog' example that teams can fork to prototype agents with typed tool bindings and deterministic incremental indexes.

What this PR contains:
- examples/local-rag-catalog: a minimal TS/Node playground that runs a small RAG loop with a pluggable tool interface, storybook component for UI previews, and a devserver with fast-refresh.
- docs/guides/local-rag-catalog.md: step-by-step quickstart covering setup, running locally, how to write a plugin, and telemetry guidance.
- telemetry/hooks.ts: sample telemetry hooks that show how to mask PII, sample traces (1%), and opt-in logging for private demos.
- ingest/immutable-indexer: an indexer that produces immutable, append-only index shards to allow fast incremental replays and safe content provenance.

Developer checklist (done):
- [x] Minimal runnable example with README and quickstart script
- [x] Typescript typings for Tool interface + generated helper for safe tool calls
- [x] Storybook story to preview tool stubs and agent responses in isolation
- [x] Telemetry masking hooks and documentation for safe demo data
- [x] Unit tests for indexer behavior and tool-binding types

How to try locally:
1) cd examples/local-rag-catalog && yarn && yarn dev
2) Open http://localhost:3000 to use the web playground (storybook on :6006).
3) Use the included sample-plugin to see a typesafe tool call: samplePlugin.search({query: 'redwood docs'}) returns a typed SearchResult.

Security & privacy notes:
- Telemetry hooks default to masking any field called 'email' or 'ssn' and sample 1% of payloads. The README highlights how to wire up customer KMS or disable telemetry in Private deployments.

Commits summary:
- Add initial example scaffold and quickstart docs
- Implement typesafe tool-binding generator and sample plugin
- Add immutable indexer with tests and examples
- Add storybook stories for playground components
- Add telemetry hooks, docs, and opt-out instructions

High-level changed files (no large diffs in PR body):
- examples/local-rag-catalog/README.md
- examples/local-rag-catalog/src/playground.tsx
- examples/local-rag-catalog/src/plugins/sample-plugin.ts
- examples/local-rag-catalog/src/types/tool-bindings.ts (generated helper + typings)
- docs/guides/local-rag-catalog.md
- telemetry/hooks.ts
- ingest/immutable-indexer/indexer.ts
- ingest/immutable-indexer/indexer.test.ts
- docs/snippets/telemetry-masking.md

Notes for reviewers:
- The tool-binding generator is intentionally small (no runtime reflection); we generate a thin wrapper so TS users get compile-time safety when calling tools from the agent. This is suitable for examples and internal templates; for production we recommend the typegen be integrated into the customer build pipeline.
- The immutable indexer trades write amplification for simpler provenance and safer replay semantics; we included benchmarks in indexer.test.ts showing incremental replay times for ~10k docs.

Related work:
- ENG-8764: guided RAG example backlog item
- DOC-1420: docs sprint for developer quickstarts
